about.title: Present
body: Euan a ceramicist based in Scotland. I make work by hand, and find most of my inspiration somewhere between the studio and the coast.

Euan studied ceramics at Grays School of Art, where I developed a practice rooted in material honesty and careful making.




As a ceramicist, Euan believes that beauty lies in the contrast between the organic forms of nature, with its rough and unpredictable textures that give life to every landscape.

The way elements come together to create shapes, shadows and contrasting textures is an endless source of inspiration for him.

He is fascinated by the way that nature can be both beautiful and harsh, soothing and jarring, subtle and bold – often at the same time.

In his work, he seeks to capture the essence of these contrasts, illuminating the tension between smooth and rough, sharp and soft, light and shadow.

By using clay as his medium, he aims to create both functional and sculptural pieces that blur the boundaries between art and everyday life, awakening a deeper connection to the natural world and its delicate balance between order and chaos.

Euan now work as technician & Ceramics teacher running the studio and teaching people at all stages of their practice. I find the teaching side genuinely rewarding - watching someone develop a feel for clay is one of those things that doesn't get old. Alongside that, I continue to develop my own collections, while experimenting within my own practice
This site is home to that work. If something resonates, I'd love to hear from you.

work.intro: Euan works in small runs - each piece thrown by hand and finished at its own pace. Nothing is exactly repeated. What you'll find here is my current work.

contact.intro: Whether you're interested in buying a piece, commissioning something, or just want to know more - I'm happy to hear from you. Use the form below or drop me a line directly.
